{{Quote|Manju is a spice trafficker and slaver, Khobisho is a negotiator and advocate for the Cartel, and Prodoranya runs an industrial moon.|Katha Niar|<ref name="ROTHC">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]''</ref>}}
'''Manju''' was a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] spice trafficker and slaver during the [[Conquest of Makeb]] in [[3638 BBY]]. [[Archon (Hutt)|Archon]] [[Szajin]] told Manju, [[Khobisho]], and [[Prodoranya]] that [[Solida Hesk]]'s palace would be a safe place for them to stay. Manju's slavers were among the most fearsome in the Galaxy, and Manju had once boasted they brought a Sith Lord before him in chains, although the validity of this claim was sketchy at best.<ref name="ROTHC" />
